title: Chinese Union Version (1919), simplified script, full Bible, one verse per line
notes: License: 'public-domain' is stated for translation id 'cmn_cu89s' in the eBible corpus licence table https://github.com/BibleNLP/ebible/blob/2bde52b4c2cfd7056cf4ed07c48969647df79744/metadata/licences.tsv (taken from eBible.org's copyright page, https://ebible.org/cmn_cu89s/copr.htm). The url pins a fixed commit, so the bytes do not change. 3,227,312 bytes; eBible corpus format: one verse per line aligned to a fixed versification (empty lines for verses the translation lacks; '<range>' marks merged verses, a few letters each). vs/refcorpus.normalize(..., 'chinese') gives 1,044,463 characters. Chinese has no word spaces: the generic normalization keeps each punctuation-delimited phrase as one 'word', so the grid's word-level statistics see phrase-length units; power figures for Chinese should be read in that light.
